name: Jellio++
description:
This plugin provides integration between Jellyfin and the Jellio++ service.
Fork of InfiniteAvenger/jellio-plus.

versions.changelog:
## What's Changed

### Features

- **Audio track selection**: a source with two or more audio tracks played only the default one. Now there's one Stremio entry per audio track. (fixes [#19](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/issues/19))

### Fixes

- **Public URL fixes** (fixes [#6](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/issues/6)):
  - **Public Base URL field is always visible**: it only showed when Jellyseerr was on. It is now always shown.
  - **Install URLs use the Public Base URL**: they used the address from your browser bar, so opening the config page over LAN gave Stremio an address it could not reach. They now use the Public Base URL you set.
  - **Copy install URL works over plain HTTP**: Copy did nothing on pages served over plain HTTP. The URL now shows in a field you can select and copy by hand.
- **All three install URLs show at once**: they were behind a dropdown, one at a time.
- **Security**: dropped `axios` - a dependency with 16 high-severity issues. ([#13](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/13))

## Under the Hood

Dev-only changes:

- **Docker dev environment**: `docker compose up -d` starts Jellyfin and Stremio, and `npm run dev` serves the config UI against mocked backend calls. ([#11](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/11))
- **Tests run on every push and pull request**: they used to run only at release time, and only the .NET suite. Both suites now run per push and per pull request. ([#23](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/23))
- **Pre-commit hooks**: `prettier` and `eslint` now run on staged files. ([#8](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/8))
- **Lint and formatting cleanup**: no `prettier` and `eslint` issues anymore. ([#9](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/9), [#10](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/10))
- **Web toolchain**: ([#7](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/pull/7))
  - tsconfigs extend `@tsconfig/vite-react` and `@tsconfig/node24`
  - Node is pinned to `24.15.0`
  - TypeScript is bumped from 5.7 to 6.0.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0

## What's Changed

- **Stream URLs now respect `PublicBaseUrl`**: fixes streams when Jellyfin runs behind a reverse proxy. ([#1](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus/pull/1))
- **Stream `behaviorHints` with OpenSubtitles hash, filename, and file size**: external subtitle addons like OpenSubtitles now get accurate matches instead of falling back to title or IMDB ID. ([#2](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus/pull/2))
- **Switched streaming to HLS**: fixes seeking and the progress bar, enables proper transcoding (passthrough where possible, partial or full only when needed), no more forced stereo downmix. ([#4](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus/pull/4))
- **Stremio addon version reads from the assembly**: was hardcoded to `0.0.1`, now stays in sync with the plugin version automatically. ([#3](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus/pull/3))
- **Rebranded to Jellio++**: `/jellio` routes are now `/jelliopp`, Stremio addon ID changed. Existing installs need to be reinstalled in Stremio. ([#5](https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus/pull/5))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wujekbogdan/jellio-plus/commits/v1.5.0
